propositions: Assertions in test_reconcile_pass.py incorrectly expect 'OK:' output from the sync route, but __main__.py:437 gates OK: emission on route not in {'preview','sync'}, so sync route never prints it.

The canonical sync route emits BRIDGE_STATE: converged on stderr and RECON telemetry (differ totals and batch_outcome lines) instead of OK: on stdout; test assertions must parse stderr signals instead.

The idempotence cell (test_a_repeated_dc_reconcile_pass_writes_nothing) requires not just BRIDGE_STATE: converged but also zero differ totals and zero batch_outcome lines to prove no mutations were written.

Two helper functions _assert_converged_writing_pass and _assert_wrote_nothing must be rewritten to assert against the actual sync route output contract: stderr BRIDGE_STATE and RECON signals, not stdout OK: line.
Output parsing logic must move to a dependency-free module so unit tests can verify the contract without live Jira credentials or network access.
